name: com.gamedistrict.memoryshield
description:
Static memory audit for Unity projects. Scans assets, scenes and code and reports what will cost memory at runtime: heavy and misconfigured textures, atlas padding waste, audio import mistakes, scene bloat, and code patterns that keep assets alive past their scene. Pure project-side analysis — never runs the game, never talks to Play.

Open via Tools > GD MemoryShield.
